editorial.blurb: A beloved Chicago brunch institution where scratch-made pancakes and creative egg dishes draw loyal crowds to a warm, welcoming room.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early on weekends to beat the rush, or embrace the lively energy—staff stays cheerful and prompt even when packed. Split a sweet pancake dish with your table to sample multiple flavor combinations.
signatureDishes: Pancakes (white chocolate & caramel pretzel, cranberry limoncello, creative seasonal varieties)
